items.text: Fiberon™ PA612-ESD is sensitive to moisture and should always be stored and used under dry conditions (relative humidity below 20%).
Normally, the life of a brass nozzle would be approximately 9h.
Abrasion of the brass nozzle happens frequently when printing Fiberon™ PA612-ESD.
A wear-resistance nozzle, such as hardened steel and ruby nozzle, is highly recommended to be used with Fiberon™ PA612-ESD.
Otherwise, the support structure can be permanently bonded to the model.
If Fiberon™ PA612-ESD is used as the support material for itself, please remove the support structure before excessive moisture absorption.

items.text: All polyamides take up water when kept in a moist environment... Irreversible chemical damage to the material can only be caused by water or aqueous solutions at high temperatures. This is referred to as hydrolysis.
